behavior: Identify process creation events for powershell.exe or pwsh.exe with encoded-command switches (-enc, -encodedcommand) or download-related commands such as DownloadString, Invoke-WebRequest, or bitsadmin. Correlate parent process, command line and destination indicators for analyst triage.

test_scenarios: Benign PowerShell without encoded or download arguments
title: Encoded PowerShell execution with suspicious download
